Court No. - 76

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3593 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohd Arif

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Karan Singh Yadav
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Sanjay Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Arun Kumar, learned Advocate holding brief for Sri Karan Singh Yadav, learned counsel for the informant as well as Sri Pranshu Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 319 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Pipri, District Kaushambi, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

4. As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have married the informant as per Muslim rites on 29.2.2020 and is stated to have subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry and there are particular allegations against the applicant of having caused her miscarriage and there are allegations of gang rape against the co-accused persons.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has the apprehension of his arrest.
The applicant has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
It is next stated that the said allegations have been found false by the investigating officer and only the final report has been submitted u/s 498-A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act.

It is next stated that all the Sections are bailable except Section 498-A IPC.
6.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal antecedents.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

7. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

8. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case
, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
Mohd Arif
vs State Of U.P.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
